title: Concrete masonry columns.
officialText:
The fire-resistance rating of concrete masonry columns shall be determined
based upon the least plan dimension of the column in accordance with Table 721.3.5 or by approved alternate
methods.
TABLE 721.3.5
MINIMUM DIMENSION OF
CONCRETE MASONRY COLUMNS (inches)
FIRE-RESISTANCE RATING (hours)
1 2 3 4
8 10 12 14
For SI: 1 inch = 25.4 mm.
